issues.description: The PersonResource implementation in the solution uses different types for the same path variable 'personId': updatePerson declares the @PathVariable as String while deletePerson declares it as UUID. This contradicts the NoteResource which consistently uses UUID for the analogous noteId path variable. Students implementing the PUT endpoint (based on the NoteResource example and the problem description referencing UUIDs) may be confused whether to use UUID or String for the personId path variable; the inconsistency could lead to subtle bugs or test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the path variable type consistent across endpoints and aligned with the NoteResource and the problem statement by changing updatePerson to accept @PathVariable("personId") UUID personId and compare updatedPerson.getId().equals(personId). Alternatively, if Strings are preferred, change deletePerson to accept a String and compare to updatedPerson.getId().toString(), but using UUID is recommended for clarity and type safety.

issues.description: The problem statement and the intended API treat the path variable {personId} as a UUID (the CRUD endpoints refer to person UUIDs). In the solution, the PersonResource.updatePerson method accepts the personId path variable as a String and compares it to updatedPerson.getId().toString(), while the deletePerson endpoint accepts a UUID parameter. This mixed representation of the same conceptual entity (the personId path variable) across endpoints (String vs UUID) creates an unnecessary inconsistency and cognitive burden for students who expect a uniform UUID handling as described in the problem statement and exemplified by NoteResource.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a consistent UUID type for the personId path variable across all endpoints. Change updatePerson to accept UUID personId (e.g., @PathVariable("personId") UUID personId) and validate with updatedPerson.getId().equals(personId) so it matches the delete endpoint and the UUID usage described in the problem statement and shown in NoteResource.
